title: A FLEXIBLE LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS GUARDRAIL DEVELOPMENT METHODOLOGY APPLIED TO OFF-TOPIC PROMPT DETECTION
reasoning: The paper focuses on a technical methodology for developing guardrails to detect off-topic prompts in LLM interactions. While it mentions alignment and safety, and generalizes to harmful prompts via benchmarks like HarmBench, it does not evaluate religious beliefs, faith traditions, or specific moral/ethical reasoning frameworks.
